text:
Priya: Okay, did you finish the season yet? Because I need to talk to someone about episode eight.
Tom: Not yet! I'm on episode six. Do not spoil anything, I mean it.
Priya: I won't, I won't. But, ugh, I'm dying here. Can I at least say that I did not see it coming?
Tom: That's already a spoiler, Priya. Now I'm paranoid about every character.
Priya: Fine, fine. Just tell me, who's your favourite so far?
Tom: Honestly, the detective. The way she never really says what she's thinking, and then, bam, she solves the whole thing in one sentence. Her partner is hilarious too, the guy who is always eating.
Priya: Yes! His one-liners are the best part. Remember the scene in the diner, where he orders four desserts and says it's research?
Tom: Ha, that scene was gold. And the soundtrack is great as well, that kind of moody synth stuff.
Priya: The music is by the same guy who did that sci-fi series a few years ago. Anyway, how many more episodes do you have?
Tom: Four, I think. I'll watch two tonight and two tomorrow. Then we can talk about everything.
Priya: Deal. Text me when you're done. And be prepared to scream, that's all I'm saying.
Tom: Now I'm nervous. Okay, bye, I'm going to go make popcorn.
Priya: Enjoy! Talk soon.
